title: TESS transit candidates and two further results, 2026
description: Transit timing, light-curve tables, false-positive checks, TRICERATOPS runs and predicted transit times for four transit candidates found in TESS full-frame images: TIC 402710280 (Gaia DR3 5828441289812582400; P = 36.34005 d, depth about 1680 ppm, 5.3 h, transit-timing variations up to 29 min; two archival HARPS epochs), TIC 324429952 (Gaia DR3 6416596855786566528; P = 42.37574 d, depth about 1500 ppm), TIC 89247735 (Gaia DR3 6708071581514074368, SCR J1820-4533; P = 18.32317 d, dilution-corrected depth 1.13-1.22 %, 4.5 h, Rp about 8.7 Earth radii with the stellar radius from an SED fit) and TIC 455017950 (HD 134147, HIP 74344, Gaia DR3 5825217968423162752; P = 40.60565 d, dilution-corrected depth about 1310 ppm, 4.7 h, Rp about 3.2 Earth radii; SOAR speckle limits from the literature). Two further results: the eclipsing binary TIC 11613676 (CD-30 448, Gaia DR3 5029330944688623360; P = 12.1158 d), whose eclipses were absent in TESS sector 3 (2018), present in sector 30 (2020), 5.4 % and 2.2 % deep in sector 97 (2025) and shallower in sectors 104 and 106 (2026), with eclipse-timing variations; and TOI-540 b (TIC 200322593), whose transits, present in TESS sectors 4-32, are not detected in TESS sector 98 (2025-2026), with the checks made and the ground-based transit windows that would test the observation. The tables are recomputed from public MAST, Gaia and ESO archive products by the scripts in the repository. AI-produced, not peer reviewed; the candidates are not confirmed.
